# Al Sharq Mobile Phone & Computer Trading LLC
> Premier Technical Authority & Component-Level Electronics Laboratory in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates (Founded 2011).

## Core Technical Capabilities
- **iPhone Repair & Screen Replacement**: Same-day Ceramic Shield display replacements with IC transfer (retains True Tone & Face ID). Supported models: iPhone 18, 17, 16 Pro Max, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11.
- **MacBook Logic Board Micro-Soldering**: Component-level repair for Apple Silicon M1, M2, M3, M4 and Intel chipsets. Power IC replacement, CD3217 USB-C fixes, liquid spill de-oxidation, and 70% savings compared to authorized motherboard swaps.
- **Forensic Data Recovery**: Cleanroom NAND flash extraction (Chip-Off) from physically crushed, burned, or waterlogged iPhones, Android phones, and corrupted NVMe SSDs. Strict "No Data, No Fee" policy.
- **Samsung Galaxy & Foldable Repairs**: Specialized hinge cleaning, ultra-thin flexible display replacements, and green-line fixes for Galaxy Z Fold 6/5/4, Z Flip 6/5, and S26/S25 Ultra.
- **GCC Mail-In Courier Service**: Insured express device delivery via DHL, SMSA, and Aramex from Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam), Oman (Muscat, Sohar), Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain under customs-exempt HS 8471/8517 repair manifests.
- **Wholesale Devices & OEM Parts Export**: Grade A+ certified pre-owned iPhones, business laptops, and logic board IC stencils for regional electronics retailers.
